participant_id.Description: The participant identifier indicates the participant that was scanned.

session_id.Description: The session identifier indicates the longitudinal session at which the participant was scanned.

Levels.ses-1: The first neuroimaging session; all participants went through at least one neuroimaging session
Levels.ses-2: The second neuroimaging session (not all participants have a second session)
Levels.ses-3: The third neuroimaging session (not all participants have a third session)

mean_FD.Description: A measure of overall head movement, creating by adding the frame-to-frame differences in head motion parameters and taking the average over all time points

raw_neighborhood_corr.Description: A measure of the similarity of diffusion-weighted images to their immediate spatial neighbors; checks how well intensity patterns in each voxel agree with those in its local 3D neighborhood

num_outlier_bundles.Description: For that subject and session, the number of outlier bundles, determined as a bundle with a total volume greater or less than 3 standard deviations from the mean volume for that bundle across subjects and sessions. This includes those that are missing the bundle completely (N/A)

num_missing_bundles.Description: For that subject and session, the number of bundles they are missing completely (N/A)

qc_determination.Description: The final determination of the scan's quality.

Levels.Fail: The scan fails QC. A scan failed for use in scalar map figures if it had a mean FD > 2.8, determined based on the visual scatterplot outliers of neighbohorhood corr vs. mean FD. A scan failed from a bundle basis if a subject/session had greater than 30 outlier bundles.
Levels.Pass: The scan passes QC and should be included in analyse.
